这个模组包含游戏《无期迷途》的禁闭者（游戏角色）摆件。
This mod includes dolls of the Sinners/characters from the game "Path to Nowhere".

2.1 做完了所有禁闭者摆件以及部分皮肤。Completed all Sinners/characters figurines and part of the skins.
（更新至11.27号， 138 位禁闭者坚韧系22名，狂暴系25名，诡秘系23名，精准系22名，异能系22名，启迪系24名）
(Updated to November 27— 138 “Sinners/characters” in total: 22 Endura, 25 Fury, 23 Umbra, 22 Reticle, 22 Arcane, 24 Catalyst.)

其中完成了部分角色皮肤：辰砂"谦候致意",安吉尔"旗袍",白逸"凛锋夜行",琳(无头盔),娜恰"酣眠初醒",奥古斯特"凯瑟琳红裙",兰利"恶海女爵",瑟琳"夜华如昼""黯夜同行",恩菲尔"璞玉灼灼",可可莉克"盛放",卡门奈特"酩酊诱梦",哈梅尔"欢愉调",切尔西伯爵"遗落心湖",温蒂"链锯惊魂夜",橡木匣"黑夜的葬仪",女局"原皮""问日辉""花时君至""假日闲情""居家""执锋裁约""静谧浮华""冒险家""是夜无眠""小向导""鎏尘祈谕"

支持按照[b][color=#ff7700][size=3]禁闭者“职业”[/size][/color][/b]选择:是否启用该“职业”全部禁闭者摆件。（在游戏内自行定义。）
Support selection by [b][color=#ff7700]“Tendency”[/color][/b]: allows enabling or disabling all figurines belonging to a specific Tendency. (Definition customizable in-game.)
[size=4]-------------------------------
安装方式： Installation:
[/size]
下载文件-（本mod需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smap[/url]i和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher[/url]和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]）-将文件解压到“Mods”文件
Download the file - (This mod requires SMAPI,Content Patcher, and Generic Mod Config Menu GMCM) - Extract the file to the "Mods" folder.

[size=1]*ps：Smapi 安装可以搜教程（不放在mods文件夹里），ContentPatcher和GMCM需要放在mods文件夹里！！！（总的来说，smapi需要安装，"Mods"文件夹要包含ContentPatcher、Generic Mod Config Menu和这个模组）
*PS: You can search for tutorials on how to install SMAPI (it should not be placed in the "Mods" folder). Content Patcher and GMCM needs to be placed in the "Mods" folder! (In summary, SMAPI needs to be installed, and the "Mods" folder should contain both Content Patcher, GMCM, and this mod.)[/size]

游戏内使用：
In-game usage:

打开家具目录-装饰那部分就能翻到（应该）
Open the Furniture catalog , in the Decor section. (Probably）

（ps：如果用了CJB，也可以直接在cjb里面搜角色名字。中英文都可以，英文参照无期迷途英文版名字，不是拼音）
(P.S. If you are using CJB, you can also search for the character names directly in CJB. Both Chinese and English are acceptable, but the English names should follow the naming conventions used in the English version of "Path to Nowhere" , not the Pinyin.)

打开游戏内“mod定义器”可以自行选择打开/关闭 不同职业禁闭者摆件（默认全选。）
Open the in-game “Mod Definer” to manually enable or disable figurines from different Tendencies. (All are enabled by default.)
